description: Write an organisation's #payoutSettings: its payouts service (`facilitator`), the ONE way it pays people (rails: a one-item list of `chain`, `usdc_base` or `stripe`) and the verifiers it allows (`oracles`, default first; the post form offers only these). To add a verifier, pass the current list with the new one appended (or first, to make it the default): the list replaces the old one, so a verifier left out is removed. Previews by default: current settings, new settings, every change and the warnings. Show that to the person, then call again with the same values and confirm: true to sign one transaction (old settings out, new in). Refused unless the signing account has a key on the organisation, the payouts service answers /health and every verifier resolves. Success is reported only after the ledger reads back exactly what was asked. Spends only network fees.

confirm.description: false (the default) previews; true signs the one transaction.

currency.description: What amounts the payouts service pays are quoted in. Absent: USD.

facilitator.description: The company's payouts facilitator: a did:web or an https URL. Needed for usdc_base and stripe.

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

oracles.description: The verifiers the company allows, default first: each a `did:web` or the verifier's `did:ixo:entity:…`.

rails.description: How the company pays people, ONE of: `chain` (held in each ask, from the organisation account), `usdc_base`, `stripe`. A one-item list; more than one is refused.

name: set_payout_settings
title: Set an organisation's payout settings
